mentions.name: exp-dhewm3
mentions.description: A modified Doom 3 renderer (built on dhewm3) that implements John Carmack's experimental shadow mapping approach found in the GPLed Doom 3 code, adding Poisson disc sampling and fixing the peter panning artifact present in the original experimental renderer. The author includes visual comparisons of shadow mapping versus the original stencil shadows.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've decided to go on that rabbit hole of Doom 3 graphics, specifically Carmack's experimental renderer and ended up implementing his approach, as well as adding some poisson disc sampling and fixed the peter panning: https://github.com/klaussilveira/exp-dhewm3
